questions.question: In automata basics, a symbol is defined as a:
questions.explanation: A symbol is a character; an alphabet is a finite set of symbols, a word a finite set of alphabets and a language a finite set of words.

questions.concept: Bubble sort list after three passes
questions.question: Bubble sort (ascending) is applied to [7, 11, 3, 10, 17, 23, 1, 4, 21, 5]. What is the list after three complete passes?
questions.explanation: Pass 1 moves 23 to the end, pass 2 places 21 and pass 3 places 17, giving [3, 7, 10, 1, 4, 11, 5, 17, 21, 23]. The second option is the state after only two passes.

questions.concept: Radio wave frequency that penetrates walls
questions.question: Radio waves in which frequency range can penetrate walls?
questions.explanation: Radio waves of 3-300 KHz penetrate walls; 300 KHz-30 MHz travel long distances, while microwaves and infrared cannot penetrate solid objects.

questions.concept: Design stage involves algorithm and flowchart
questions.question: In the SDLC stages, preparing the algorithm and flowchart for the solution is done during:
questions.explanation: The Design stage involves the algorithm and flowchart; coding is done in Development.

questions.question: Which OOP feature can be implemented using encapsulation?
questions.explanation: By wrapping data inside a class and exposing only selected members, encapsulation makes it possible to achieve abstraction.

questions.question: In CASE tools, which component stores all project-related changes and information from development through maintenance?
questions.explanation: The CASE repository is the central store of all project-related information and changes, from development to maintenance.

questions.question: Sophia, which uses AI, visual data processing, facial recognition and human-like gestures, is an example of which type of robot?
questions.explanation: Sophia is a humanoid, a robot that resembles humans.

questions.question: Which HTML tag is used to create scrolling text?
questions.explanation: The <marquee> tag creates a scrolling effect; <center> only centres content.

questions.question: In a star topology, which failure can disrupt the entire network?

options.A: Failure of the terminator at one end of the bus
options.B: Failure of the central hub or switch
options.C: Failure of the cable to a single node
options.D: Failure of any one end device

questions.explanation: Failure of one device in a star does not affect others, but the central node is a single point of failure.

questions.question: While typing a multiline SQL statement in the MySQL client, what does the prompt change to until the statement is completed with a semicolon?
questions.explanation: For multiline statements the prompt changes from mysql> to -> until the statement is terminated with a semicolon.

questions.concept: White hat hacker is a penetration tester
questions.question: An ethical hacker who legally tests a system with the owner's permission, also called a penetration tester, is a:
questions.explanation: White hat hackers are ethical hackers or penetration testers who have permission to hack the system.

questions.concept: count() and index() on a list
questions.question:
What is the output of the following code?
lst = [5, 3, 5, 7, 5]
print(lst.count(5), lst.index(7))
questions.explanation: 5 appears three times, and the first occurrence of 7 is at index 3 (indices start from 0).

questions.question: What is the Hamming distance between the codewords 1011101 and 1001001?
questions.explanation: Comparing bit by bit, the words differ only at the 3rd and 5th positions, so the Hamming distance is 2.

questions.concept: if-elif chain stops at first true condition
questions.explanation: In an if..elif..else chain, only the block of the first true condition runs and the structure ends, so only A is printed even though x > 5 is also true.

questions.question: What kind of code is ASCII?
questions.explanation: Every ASCII character uses the same number of bits, so ASCII is a fixed length code.

questions.question: What is the range of values supported by the MySQL DATE data type?
questions.explanation: The MySQL DATE type stores dates in YYYY-MM-DD format with a range from 1000-01-01 to 9999-12-31.

questions.concept: Number of pages for 16-bit logical address and 4K page
questions.question: A logical address is 16 bits long and the page size is 4 KB. How many pages does the logical address space contain?
questions.explanation: 4 KB = 2^12, so the offset is 12 bits and the page number is 16 - 12 = 4 bits, giving 2^4 = 16 pages.

questions.question: In the formal definition of a Linear Bounded Automaton, what does ML represent?
questions.explanation: ML is the left end marker and MR the right end marker of an LBA.

questions.concept: Lower bound and upper bound of an array
questions.question: In array terminology, what are the lower bound and upper bound?

options.A: The first and last elements after sorting
options.B: The base address and the last address of the array
options.C: The smallest and largest values stored in the array
options.D: The smallest and largest valid index values

questions.explanation: Lower bound and upper bound refer to the smallest and largest valid index values, not to the stored values or addresses.

questions.question: Which option lists correct protocol-port pairs?
questions.explanation: SMTP uses 25 and DNS 53; the other options swap Telnet/SSH (23/22), POP3/IMAP (110/143) and HTTP/HTTPS (80/443).

questions.concept: Cyber forensics combines law and computer science
questions.question: Which field combines law and computer science to collect and analyse digital evidence?
questions.explanation: Cyber forensics combines law and computer science to collect and analyse information as digital evidence.

questions.concept: Function not performed by IoT gateway
questions.question: Which of the following is NOT a key functionality of an IoT gateway?

options.C: Converting energy into motion to drive devices
options.D: Providing local storage as cache or buffer

questions.explanation: Gateways aggregate data, cache it locally, compute at the edge, add security and run diagnostics. Converting energy into motion is the job of actuators.

questions.question: Processes P1, P2 and P3 arrive at time 0 with CPU bursts of 24 ms, 3 ms and 3 ms. What is the average waiting time under non-preemptive SJF?
questions.explanation: SJF runs P2 (0-3), P3 (3-6), then P1 (6-30). Waiting times are 0, 3 and 6, so the average is 9 / 3 = 3 ms.

questions.question: Which attribute of the body tag sets a background colour rather than a background image?
questions.explanation: bgcolor sets the background colour, while background sets a background image.
